definition: the nearby area around where you live
description: On a cobbled street in a hillside quarter of brightly painted houses, a young man in a yellow vest keeps a football up with his foot while a bigger man in a dark T-shirt watches him. People come out of the doorways and windows of the houses around them and a game starts in the middle of the street, with folded shirts and a small metal frame for goals and women watching from balconies and doorsteps. It ends with all the players running together into one laughing huddle in the road.

de.answer: Sie spielen auf einer Straße mit Kopfsteinpflaster Fußball.
de.question: Was machen die Männer?

es.answer: Están jugando al fútbol en una calle adoquinada.
es.question: ¿Qué están haciendo los hombres?

fr.answer: Ils jouent au football dans une rue pavée.
